title: Jehoshaphat Strengthens Judah and Sends Out Teachers
description: King Jehoshaphat strengthens his kingdom and walks in the ways of the Lord. In his third year as king, he sends officials, Levites, and priests throughout the cities of Judah to teach the people from the Book of the Law of the Lord. Fear of the Lord falls upon neighboring nations; the Philistines and Arabs bring gifts, and Jehoshaphat builds fortresses and gathers a large army.
